page: Google Cloud Platform e2-highcpu-2 is an x86_64 architecture instance belonging to the E2 server family. It features 2 vCPUs mapped to 1 physical Intel Xeon core running at 2.2 GHz, with 2 threads per core and dedicated CPU allocation. The system is equipped with 2.0 GB of RAM, providing a resource density of 1.0 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware.

Performance benchmarks place this instance in the lower tiers. Single-core CPU performance via stress-ng is measured at 1105.98, while multi-core performance reaches 1452.89. Memory bandwidth is limited, with read-only large block speeds at 13.03 GB/sec and write speeds at 11.11 GB/sec. The instance achieves a Geekbench single-core score of 906.0 and a multi-core score of 1073.0, reflecting its entry-level compute capabilities.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the e2-highcpu-2 offers a low-cost entry point for workloads requiring dedicated CPU allocation but minimal memory. The lack of bundled local storage and GPUs, combined with its modest performance profile, makes it suitable for lightweight, non-resource-intensive applications. Appropriate workloads include basic static web serving, small-scale Redis operations, minor text processing, and simple background utility tasks.
